comment: Which client data a seat keeps inside its own launch directory. Class K: the client keeps its growing data (a database, snapshots, logs) in XDG_DATA_HOME/<dataDir>; the seat gets a fresh data home and, for each name in seed, a byte copy of that file from the user's data home (the content is never read or printed; the copy is removed at seat end in every completion class). A client is active only when enabled is true; otherwise it is unseated with the reason given and keeps writing where it wrote before (the pulse watches that). Class O: the home is shared with interactive work and holds rotating tokens; nothing is copied, and the growing sub-folders are moved by one prepared operator step of the source repository.

kilo.reason: auth.json is the one credential file the client reads from its data home (.ai/bin/access/kilo-config.cjs names it); the readers of the seat data are the farm session export of the owner's own kilo database (not a seat) and the usage accounting, which reads the client's stream output

opencode.reason: the data home holds no credential file (names listed 2026-11-19) and the seat already runs with an empty config home, so access is by environment; the seat data is read by no repository reader

mimo.reason: unseated: the usage backfill (.ai/bin/accounting/lib/client-usage.cjs) reads mimocode.db of the home after the seat ended, and no collector copies its numbers before the seat folder is removed; the client keeps its data home until that reader is fed

codex.reason: OAuth tokens with rotation share the home with interactive work; the growing part moves by junction (the prepared operator step)

vibe.reason: six readers use the fixed home path (accounting session logs, the access probe, the history archive); the growing part moves by junction (the prepared operator step)

claude.reason: the owner's and the operator's own sessions live here; the growing part moves by junction (the prepared operator step)

kimi.reason: small home (0.35 GB); watched by the pulse, nothing moves

gemini.reason: small home (0.37 GB); watched by the pulse, nothing moves

cline.reason: small home (0.58 GB); watched by the pulse, nothing moves
